# L.D Construction

> Joiners and builders based in Bellshill, North Lanarkshire (near Glasgow), working across Scotland. All joinery and construction work for homes and commercial spaces.

Phone: 07311 822986 (also on WhatsApp)
Website: https://ldconstruction.trade

## What they do
Loft conversions, roofing (hand-cut timber roofs, slate and lead repairs), joinery and oak work, renovations, kitchens, bathrooms, windows, doors, glazing, PVC, gutters, gardens and fencing, excavation and groundwork including septic tank installation.

- [Home](https://ldconstruction.trade/): who they are and where they work
- [Our work](https://ldconstruction.trade/work/): photographs of recent jobs, taken on site
- [Services](https://ldconstruction.trade/services/): what they take on
- [Get a quote](https://ldconstruction.trade/quote/): call or message on WhatsApp with photos and what needs doing
